words.gloss: having the nature of a reed

hindi: "बलवान् द्वारा आक्रान्त दुर्बल राजा सब प्रकार से झुका हुआ, बेंत के स्वभाव वाला होकर रहे।
english: "A weak king attacked by a stronger one should remain submissive in every way, behaving like a reed.
notes: Opening quotation mark in src belongs to the edition (a cited opinion, closed in 12.01.2). vetasa-dharmā: bahuvrīhi, literally 'whose dharma is that of the reed' (bending, not breaking).
lines_deva: "बलीयसा-अभियुक्तो दुर्बलः सर्वत्र-अनुप्रणतो वेतस.धर्मा तिष्ठेत्

hindi: क्योंकि जो बलवान् के आगे झुकता है, वह इन्द्र के आगे झुकता है" — ऐसा भारद्वाज कहते हैं।
english: For he who bows to the stronger one bows to Indra," so says Bharadvaja.
notes: indrasya and balīyasaḥ are genitives used with √nam where a dative would be expected (common in prose).
lines_deva: इन्द्रस्य हि स प्रणमति यो बलीयसो नमति" इति भारद्वाजः
lines_iast: indrasya hi sa praṇamati yo balīyaso namati" iti bhāradvājaḥ

hindi: "वह अपनी सेनाओं के पूरे समूह से युद्ध करे।
english: "He should fight with the whole mass of his forces.
notes: Opening quotation: Vishalaksha's view, closed in 12.01.5.
lines_deva: "सर्व.सन्दोहेन बलानां युध्येत

hindi: क्योंकि पराक्रम विपत्ति को दूर कर देता है।
english: For valour drives away calamity.
lines_deva: पराक्रमो हि व्यसनम् अपहन्ति

hindi: और यही क्षत्रिय का स्वधर्म है — युद्ध में जय हो या पराजय" — ऐसा विशालाक्ष कहते हैं।
english: And this is the kṣatriya's own dharma: victory or defeat in battle," so says Vishalaksha.
notes: Comma after kṣatriyasya is the edition's punctuation, kept in src.
lines_deva: स्व.धर्मश् च-एष क्षत्रियस्य, युद्धे जयः पराजयो वा" इति विशाल.अक्षः
lines_iast: sva.dharmaś ca-eṣa kṣatriyasya, yuddhe jayaḥ parājayo vā" iti viśāla.akṣaḥ

hindi: "नहीं" — ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: "No," says Kautilya.
lines_deva: न-इति कौटिल्यः

hindi: जो सब प्रकार से झुका रहता है, वह घर में पले मेढ़े की भाँति जीवन की आशा छोड़कर रहता है।
english: One who is submissive in every way lives without hope for his life, like a sheep kept in the house.
notes: kula-eḍaka: a ram/sheep reared at home (the comparison implies one destined for slaughter); sandhi aḥ + i > a before iva. The alternative reading as a bahuvrīhi for the person is not needed.
lines_deva: सर्वत्र-अनुप्रणतः कुलैडक इव निराशो जीविते वसति
lines_iast: sarvatra-anupraṇataḥ kulaiḍaka iva nirāśo jīvite vasati

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. mid. part. √yudh
m. nom. sg. pres. mid. part. ava-√gāh

hindi: और थोड़ी सेना वाला युद्ध करता हुआ, बिना नाव के समुद्र में उतरने वाले की भाँति डूब जाता है।
english: And one fighting with a small army perishes, like a man plunging into the ocean without a boat.
lines_deva: युध्यमानश् च-अल्प.सैन्यः समुद्रम् इव-अप्लवो ऽवगाहमानः सीदति

hindi: किन्तु उससे अधिक बलवान् राजा का अथवा अजेय दुर्ग का आश्रय लेकर वह प्रयत्न करे।
english: But, having taken refuge with a king superior to that one, or in an unassailable fort, he should make his efforts.
notes: tad-viśiṣṭa = 'distinguished beyond him', i.e. stronger than the attacker. ceṣṭeta: 'should act / exert himself'.
lines_deva: तद्.विशिष्टं तु राजानम् आश्रितो दुर्गम् अविषह्यं वा चेष्टेत
lines_iast: tad.viśiṣṭaṃ tu rājānam āśrito durgam aviṣahyaṃ vā ceṣṭeta

hindi: आक्रमण करने वाले तीन प्रकार के होते हैं — धर्मविजयी, लोभविजयी और असुरविजयी।
english: Attackers are of three kinds: the righteous conqueror, the greedy conqueror and the demonic conqueror.
notes: vijayinaḥ with final visarga dropped before iti (aḥ + i > a). dharma-vijayin, lobha-vijayin, asura-vijayin rendered 'righteous / greedy / demonic conqueror'.
lines_deva: त्रयो ऽभियोक्तारो धर्म.लोभ.असुर.विजयिन इति

hindi: उनमें धर्मविजयी समर्पण से सन्तुष्ट हो जाता है।
english: Among them, the righteous conqueror is satisfied with submission.
notes: abhyavapatti: 'coming over to', i.e. submission, acknowledging his overlordship.
lines_deva: तेषाम् अभ्यवपत्त्या धर्म.विजयी तुष्यति

hindi: उसके आगे वह समर्पण कर दे, अन्यों के भय से भी।
english: He should submit to him, also out of fear of the others.
notes: pareṣām bhayāt: fear of the other (kinds of) attackers, or of other enemies; the Sanskrit leaves this open.
lines_deva: तम् अभ्यवपद्येत, परेषाम् अपि भयात्

hindi: लोभविजयी भूमि और द्रव्य के हरण से सन्तुष्ट होता है।
english: The greedy conqueror is satisfied by seizing land and goods.
lines_deva: भूमि.द्रव्य.हरणेन लोभ.विजयी तुष्यति

hindi: उसके आगे वह धन देकर समर्पण करे।
english: He should submit to him with wealth.
lines_deva: तम् अर्थेन-अभ्यवपद्येत

words.gloss: by seizing land, goods, sons, wives and life

hindi: असुरविजयी भूमि, द्रव्य, पुत्र, स्त्री और प्राण के हरण से (सन्तुष्ट होता है)।
english: The demonic conqueror (is satisfied) by seizing land, goods, sons, wives and life.
notes: tuṣyati is understood from 12.01.13.
lines_deva: भूमि.द्रव्य.पुत्र.दार.प्राण.हरणेन-असुर.विजयी

hindi: उसे भूमि और द्रव्य से अपने वश में करके, स्वयं पकड़ में न आते हुए, वह प्रतिकार करे।
english: Having won him over with land and goods, he should take counter-measures while remaining beyond his grasp.
notes: agrāhyaḥ: 'not to be caught', i.e. keeping himself out of the attacker's reach.
lines_deva: तं भूमि.द्रव्याभ्याम् उपगृह्य-अग्राह्यः प्रतिकुर्वीत

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. mid. part. ud-√sthā

hindi: उनमें से किसी एक को अपने विरुद्ध उठते हुए वह सन्धि से, मन्त्रयुद्ध से अथवा कूटयुद्ध से रोके।
english: Any one of them rising against him he should counter by a treaty, by a war of counsel or by treacherous warfare.
notes: mantra-yuddha: war waged by counsel/diplomacy; kūṭa-yuddha: concealed, deceitful fighting. prativyūheta: literally 'array (troops) against'.
lines_deva: तेषाम् अन्यतमम् उत्तिष्ठमानं सन्धिना मन्त्र.युद्धेन कूट.युद्धेन वा प्रतिव्यूहेत
lines_iast: teṣām anyatamam uttiṣṭhamānaṃ sandhinā mantra.yuddhena kūṭa.yuddhena vā prativyūheta

hindi: उसके शत्रु-पक्ष को साम और दान से, तथा उसके अपने पक्ष को भेद और दण्ड से (वश में करे)।
english: (He should win over) the enemy party of that (attacker) by conciliation and gifts, and his own party by dissension and force.
notes: Verb understood from 12.01.17 (prativyūheta) or an implied 'win over'. asya = the attacker; śatru-pakṣa = those hostile to the attacker, sva-pakṣa = the attacker's own side. daṇḍa here = force/punishment (the fourth upāya), not 'army'.
lines_deva: शत्रु.पक्षम् अस्य साम.दानाभ्याम्, स्व.पक्षं भेद.दण्डाभ्याम्

hindi: गुप्तचर उसके दुर्ग, राष्ट्र अथवा सेना-शिविर को शस्त्र, विष और अग्नि से नष्ट कर दें।
english: Secret agents should destroy his fort, country or camp with weapons, poison and fire.
notes: rasa here = poison, not 'taste'. skandha-āvāra = military camp. sādhayeyuḥ: 'bring to an end, destroy / subdue'.
lines_deva: दुर्गं राष्ट्रं स्कन्ध.आवारं वा-अस्य गूढाः शस्त्र.रस.अग्निभिः साधयेयुः
lines_iast: durgaṃ rāṣṭraṃ skandha.āvāraṃ vā-asya gūḍhāḥ śastra.rasa.agnibhiḥ sādhayeyuḥ

hindi: वह सब ओर से उसका पिछला भाग पकड़वाए।
english: He should have his rear seized on all sides.
notes: pārṣṇi: the 'heel', i.e. the rear of the attacker, cf. pārṣṇi-grāha = heel-seizer.
lines_deva: सर्वतः पार्ष्णिम् अस्य ग्राहयेत्

words.gloss: by a kinsman of his family and a prince in disfavour

hindi: अथवा वह आटविकों द्वारा उसके राज्य का नाश करवाए, अथवा उसके कुल के किसी व्यक्ति और निकाले गए राजकुमार द्वारा उसे छिनवाए।
english: Or he should have his kingdom ravaged by forest tribes, or have it seized by a kinsman of his family and a prince in disfavour.
notes: tat-kulīna: a member of the attacker's own family (a rival claimant); aparuddha: a prince kept out / in disgrace. The dual may be read 'or' (one or the other agent).
lines_deva: अटवीभिर् वा राज्यं घातयेत्, तत्.कुलीन.अपरुद्धाभ्यां वा हारयेत्
lines_iast: aṭavībhir vā rājyaṃ ghātayet, tat.kulīna.aparuddhābhyāṃ vā hārayet

words.gloss: at the end of the injuries

hindi: और इन अपकारों के अन्त में वह उसके पास दूत भेजे।
english: And when these injuries have been done, he should send an envoy to him.

text_flags.why: dūta 'envoy' is spelt with dental t; retroflex ṭ (दूट) is not a word; typing error in the e-text.

notes: apakāra-anteṣu: after each injury has been inflicted. Words use the corrected dūtam.
lines_deva: अपकार.अन्तेषु च-अस्य दूटं प्रेषयेत्

hindi: अथवा बिना अपकार किए सन्धि (कर ले)।
english: Or, without doing harm, (there may be) a treaty.
notes: Nominal sentence; verb such as 'should make' understood.
lines_deva: अनपकृत्य वा सन्धानम्

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. abhi-pra-√yā

words.gloss: increasing with each day and night

hindi: फिर भी, आक्रमण के लिए बढ़ते हुए उससे वह कोश और दण्ड में एक चौथाई अधिक देकर, अथवा प्रत्येक दिन-रात बढ़ाकर, सन्धि की याचना करे।
english: Even so, he should sue the one marching against him for a treaty (offering) treasury and army increased by a quarter, or increased with every day and night.
notes: pāda-uttaram / aho-rātra-uttaram qualify sandhim: a pact whose price in treasury and troops is a quarter more (than first offered), or grows day by day. Exact sense of the escalation is uncertain.
lines_deva: तथा-अप्य् अभिप्रयान्तं कोश.दण्डयोः पाद.उत्तरम् अहो.रात्र.उत्तरं वा सन्धिं याचेत
lines_iast: tathā-apy abhiprayāntaṃ kośa.daṇḍayoḥ pāda.uttaram aho.rātra.uttaraṃ vā sandhiṃ yāceta

words.gram: n. acc. sg. ppp. caus. ud-√sah

hindi: यदि वह दण्ड-सन्धि माँगे, तो वह उसे निकम्मे हाथी-घोड़े दे, अथवा उत्साहित किए हुए विषयुक्त।
english: If he asks for a treaty of army, he should give him useless elephants and horses, or spirited ones that have been given poison.
notes: daṇḍa-sandhi: a pact in which troops are handed over. kuṇṭha: 'blunt', i.e. unfit for use. utsāhita: made spirited (looking vigorous) but dosed with poison.
lines_deva: स चेद् दण्ड.सन्धिं याचेत, कुण्ठम् अस्मै हस्त्य्.अश्वं दद्याद्, उत्साहितं वा गर.युक्तम्
lines_iast: sa ced daṇḍa.sandhiṃ yāceta, kuṇṭham asmai hasty.aśvaṃ dadyād, utsāhitaṃ vā gara.yuktam

words.gloss: troops of treasonable men, enemies and forest tribes

hindi: यदि वह पुरुष-सन्धि माँगे, तो वह उसे दूष्यों, अमित्रों और आटविकों की सेना दे, जिस पर गुप्त पुरुष नियुक्त हों।
english: If he asks for a treaty of men, he should give him troops of treasonable men, enemies and forest tribes, placed under the command of secret agents.
notes: 'If' is carried over from 12.01.25 (sa ced). yoga-puruṣa: an agent employed for secret operations.
lines_deva: पुरुष.सन्धिं याचेत, दूष्य.अमित्र.अटवी.बलम् अस्मै दद्याद् योग.पुरुष.अधिष्ठितम्
lines_iast: puruṣa.sandhiṃ yāceta, dūṣya.amitra.aṭavī.balam asmai dadyād yoga.puruṣa.adhiṣṭhitam

hindi: वह ऐसा करे जिससे दोनों का विनाश हो जाए।
english: He should so act that the destruction of both would result.
notes: 'Both' = the attacker and the troops handed over to him.
lines_deva: तथा कुर्याद् यथा-उभय.विनाशः स्यात्

words.gram: n. nom. sg. ppp. caus. ava-√man

hindi: अथवा वह उसे तीक्ष्ण पुरुषों की सेना दे, जो अपमानित होने पर विद्रोह कर दे; अथवा अपने प्रति अनुरक्त मौल सेना दे, जो उसकी विपत्ति में उसका अपकार करे।
english: Or he should give him a force of fierce men which, when slighted, would turn hostile, or hereditary troops loyal (to himself) which would do him harm in his calamity.
notes: tīkṣṇa: desperate/fierce men (a class of agents). maula: troops hereditary to the giver; anurakta = attached to the giver, so they will work against the attacker. asya = the attacker.
lines_deva: तीक्ष्ण.बलं वा-अस्मै दद्याद् यद् अवमानितं विकुर्वीत, मौलम् अनुरक्तं वा यद् अस्य व्यसने ऽपकुर्यात्
lines_iast: tīkṣṇa.balaṃ vā-asmai dadyād yad avamānitaṃ vikurvīta, maulam anuraktaṃ vā yad asya vyasane 'pakuryāt

hindi: यदि वह कोश-सन्धि माँगे, तो वह उसे ऐसी बहुमूल्य वस्तुएँ दे जिनका वह कोई खरीदार न पा सके, अथवा युद्ध के अयोग्य कुप्य दे।
english: If he asks for a treaty of treasury, he should give him valuables for which he would find no buyer, or raw material (kupya) unfit for war.
notes: sāra: articles of value (gems etc.); kupya: metals other than gold and silver and other raw produce. Subject of adhigacchet is the attacker.
lines_deva: कोश.सन्धिं याचेत, सारम् अस्मै दद्याद् यस्य क्रेतारं न-अधिगच्छेत्, कुप्यम् अयुद्ध.योग्यं वा
lines_iast: kośa.sandhiṃ yāceta, sāram asmai dadyād yasya kretāraṃ na-adhigacchet, kupyam ayuddha.yogyaṃ vā

words.gloss: whose settlement means great loss and expense

hindi: यदि वह भूमि-सन्धि माँगे, तो वह उसे ऐसी भूमि दे जो वापस ली जा सके, जिसका स्थायी शत्रु हो, जिसे कोई आश्रय न हो, अथवा जिसे बसाने में बड़ा क्षय और व्यय हो।
english: If he asks for a treaty of land, he should give him land that can be taken back, that has a permanent enemy, that is without a place of support, or whose settlement involves great loss and expense.
notes: anapāśrayā: land lacking a refuge/base (no fort or natural protection). nitya-amitrā: bordered by a constant enemy.
lines_deva: भूमि.सन्धिं याचेत, प्रत्यादेयां नित्य.अमित्राम् अनपाश्रयां महा.क्षय.व्यय.निवेशां वा-अस्मै भूमिं दद्यात्
lines_iast: bhūmi.sandhiṃ yāceta, pratyādeyāṃ nitya.amitrām anapāśrayāṃ mahā.kṣaya.vyaya.niveśāṃ vā-asmai bhūmiṃ dadyāt

hindi: अथवा राजधानी को छोड़कर अपने सर्वस्व के बदले वह बलवान् से सन्धि की याचना करे।
english: Or he should sue the stronger one for a treaty with all his possessions, excepting the capital.
notes: balīyasaḥ may be read as abl. ('from') or gen. ('of the stronger'); sense unchanged. rāja-dhānī-varjena: instrumental of exclusion, 'with the capital excepted'.
lines_deva: सर्व.स्वेन वा राज.धानी.वर्जेन सन्धिं याचेत बलीयसः
lines_iast: sarva.svena vā rāja.dhānī.varjena sandhiṃ yāceta balīyasaḥ

hindi: जो दूसरा बलपूर्वक छीन ले, उसे वह उपाय से दे दे; वह अपने शरीर की रक्षा करे, धन की नहीं — क्योंकि अनित्य धन पर दया कैसी?
english: What another would take by force, that he should give up by stratagem; he should protect his own body, not his wealth, for what pity is there for wealth that is impermanent?

text_flags.why: prayacchet (3 sg. opt. pra-√yam) + upāyataḥ gives prayacched by sandhi; 'cc' for 'cch' (प्रयच्चेद् for प्रयच्छेद्) is a typing error.

notes: Śloka: 8 syllables a quarter, metre regular. prasahya: absolutive used adverbially, 'forcibly'.
lines_deva: यत् प्रसह्य हरेद् अन्यस् तत् प्रयच्चेद् उपायतः
रक्षेत् स्व.देहं न धनं का ह्य् अनित्ये धने दया
lines_iast: yat prasahya hared anyas tat prayacced upāyataḥ
rakṣet sva.dehaṃ na dhanaṃ kā hy anitye dhane dayā
